headings: Acquisitions and Investments in Unconsolidated Affiliates
paragraphs: Armstrong World Industries, Inc. ("AWI" or the "Company") is a Pennsylvania corporation incorporated in 1891. When we refer to "we," "our" and "us" in this report, we are referring to AWI and its subsidiaries.

AWI is an Americas leader in the design and manufacture of innovative interior and exterior architectural applications including ceilings, specialty walls and exterior metal solutions. We manufacture and source products made of numerous materials, including mineral fiber, fiberglass, metal, felt, architectural resin and glass, wood, wood fiber and glass-reinforced-gypsum. We also manufacture ceiling suspension system (grid) products through a joint venture with Worthington Enterprises, Inc. called Worthington Armstrong Venture ("WAVE").
Our operating segments are as follows: Mineral Fiber, Architectural Specialties and Unallocated Corporate.

Mineral Fiber – produces suspended mineral fiber and fiberglass ceiling systems. Our mineral fiber products offer various performance attributes such as acoustical control, rated fire protection, and energy efficiency, along with other health and sustainability features and aesthetic appeal. Ceiling products are primarily sold to resale distributors, ceiling systems contractors and wholesalers, and retailers (including large home centers). The Mineral Fiber segment also includes the results of WAVE, which manufactures and sells suspension system (grid) products and ceiling component products that are invoiced by both AWI and WAVE. Segment results relating to WAVE consist primarily of equity earnings and reflect our 50% equity interest in the joint venture. Ceiling component products consist of ceiling perimeters and trim, in addition to grid products that support drywall ceiling systems, structural and walkable grid systems. For some customers, WAVE sells its suspension system products to AWI for resale to customers. Mineral Fiber segment results reflect those sales transactions. The Mineral Fiber segment also includes all assets and liabilities not specifically allocated to our Architectural Specialties or Unallocated Corporate segment, including all property and related depreciation associated with our Lancaster, Pennsylvania headquarters. Operating results for the Mineral Fiber segment include a significant majority of allocated Corporate administrative expenses that represent a reasonable allocation of general services to support its operations.

Architectural Specialties – designs, produces and sources specialty ceilings, walls, and other interior and exterior architectural applications primarily for use in commercial settings. Products are available in numerous materials, such as metal, felt, architectural resin and glass, wood, wood fiber and glass-reinforced-gypsum in various colors, shapes and designs. These products offer a range of design options and performance attributes such as acoustical control, rated fire protection, light, aesthetic appeal, energy conservation and building performance. We sell standard, premium and customized products, a portion of which are sourced from third-party producers. Architectural Specialties products are sold primarily to direct customers, primarily ceiling systems contractors, and resale distributors. This segment's revenues are primarily project driven, which can lead to more variability in sales patterns. Operating results for the Architectural Specialties segment include a portion of allocated Corporate administrative expenses that represent a reasonable allocation of general services to support its operations.

Unallocated Corporate – includes certain assets, liabilities, income and expenses that have not been allocated to our other business segments and consists of: cash and cash equivalents, our Overcast Innovations LLC investment and related equity earnings and losses, the net funded status of our U.S. Retirement Income Plan ("RIP"), the estimated fair value of interest rate swap contracts, outstanding borrowings under our senior secured credit facility and income tax balances.

Our business has been built on providing high-quality, innovative products through a highly effective service model as well as by maintaining strong brand awareness and trust. We are committed to delivering profitable revenue growth, strong cash flow generation and sustainable shareholder value by strengthening our core Mineral Fiber segment and expanding our Architectural Specialties segment into new, adjacent business categories and sectors. Through this strategy, we have delivered consistent growth in mineral fiber sales dollars per unit sold through product innovation, including our Templok® energy saving ceiling tiles, Total Acoustics® solutions and Sustain® family of products, and we have built a broad portfolio of architectural specialties products for ceilings, specialty walls and exterior metal architectural applications. Our growth initiatives continue to focus on market-driven innovation and digital tools to accelerate renovation and further differentiate our products and solutions. In addition, we continue to invest in expanding our Architectural Specialties market and reach capabilities into new adjacencies through both organic investment and acquisitions.

In December 2025, we acquired all of the issued and outstanding stock of FGM-Parallel LLC ("Parallel"), based in Englewood, Colorado. Parallel is a designer and manufacturer of extruded aluminum products primarily used in exterior architectural applications. The operations, assets and liabilities of Parallel are included in our Architectural Specialties segment.

In September 2025, we acquired all of the issued and outstanding stock of Geometrik Manufacturing, Inc. ("Geometrik"), based in Kelowna, British Columbia, Canada. Geometrik is a designer and manufacturer of wood acoustical ceiling and wall systems. The operations, assets and liabilities of Geometrik are included in our Architectural Specialties segment.

In December 2024, we acquired all of the issued and outstanding stock of A. Zahner Company ("Zahner"), based in Kansas City, Missouri. Zahner is a designer and manufacturer of exterior metal architectural solutions. The operations, assets and liabilities of Zahner are included in our Architectural Specialties segment.

In April 2024, we acquired all of the issued and outstanding membership interests in 3form, LLC ("3form"), based in Salt Lake City, Utah from Hunter Douglas, Inc. 3form is a designer and manufacturer of architectural resin and glass products used for specialty walls, partitions and ceilings. The operations, assets and liabilities of 3form are included in our Architectural Specialties segment.

In January 2024, we entered into a strategic partnership and equity investment in Overcast Innovations LLC ("Overcast") with McKinstry Essention, LLC whereby we contributed $5.5 million in exchange for an initial 19.5% ownership interest in Overcast (currently 19.2%). Overcast is a solutions company offering prefabricated ceiling cloud systems, modular grid platforms and engineering design services to reduce waste and inefficiencies in the built environment. Our investment and equity earnings and losses in Overcast are included in our Unallocated Corporate segment.

In October 2023, we acquired a portion of the business and certain assets of Insolcorp, LLC ("Insolcorp"), based in Albemarle, North Carolina. Insolcorp develops, tests and manufactures energy saving products deployed in building and roofing installations. The acquired operations, assets and liabilities of Insolcorp are included in our Mineral Fiber segment.

In July 2023, we acquired all of the issued and outstanding stock of BOK Modern, LLC ("BOK"), based in San Rafael, California. BOK is a designer of exterior metal architectural solutions. The operations, assets and liabilities of BOK are included in our Architectural Specialties segment.

headings: Sales fluctuations and changes in our relationships with key customers could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, liquidity or results of operations.
We may not experience the anticipated benefits from our strategic initiatives, including investments in product innovation and digitalization.
We cannot guarantee future cash dividend payments or future repurchases of our common stock pursuant to a share repurchase program.
Negative tax consequences can have an unanticipated effect on our financial results.
Risks Related to Legal and Regulatory Matters

Our intellectual property rights may be infringed, misappropriated, invalidated or otherwise circumvented, which could have a material adverse impact on our financial condition, liquidity or results of operations.
Risks Related to General Economic and Other Factors
Unstable market and economic conditions could have a material adverse impact on our financial condition, liquidity or results of operations.

Our business is dependent on construction activity in North America. Downturns or delays in construction activity could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, liquidity or results of operations.

Our business is dependent upon third-party vendors and suppliers whose failure to perform adequately could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, liquidity or results of operations.
Public health epidemics or pandemics could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, liquidity or results of operations.
paragraphs: The loss, reduction, or fluctuation of sales to key customers, including national home center customers or independent distributors, or any adverse change in our business relationships with them, whether as a result of changing customer demands and expectations, competition, industry consolidation, supply chain constraints or otherwise, could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, liquidity or results of operations.

If the availability of our manufacturing inputs or sourced products decreases, or the cost of those inputs or sourced products increases and we are unable to pass along increased costs resulting from supply chain or inflationary pressures, our financial condition, liquidity or results of operations could be materially and adversely affected.

The availability and cost of raw materials, packaging materials, energy and sourced products are critical to our operations and our results of operations. For example, we use substantial quantities of natural gas and some petroleum-based raw materials in our manufacturing operations. We source some materials from a limited, or single, number of suppliers, which, among other things, increases the risk of unavailability. Limited availability could require us to reformulate products or limit our production. Supply chain disruptions could decrease access to manufacturing inputs or sourced products or significantly increase the cost to purchase these items. Future input cost volatility could occur because of our suppliers' exposure to governmental trade policies, including tariffs, or geopolitical events. A decrease in availability or increases in costs of manufacturing inputs or sourced products, and any inability to pass along such costs through price increases, could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, liquidity or results of operations.

The performance of our WAVE joint venture is important to our financial results. Changes in the demand for, or quality of, WAVE products, or in the operational or financial performance of the WAVE joint venture, could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, liquidity or results of operations. Similarly, if there is a change with respect to our joint venture partner that adversely impacts its relationship with us, WAVE's performance could be materially and adversely impacted.

Our equity investment in our WAVE joint venture remains important to our financial results. WAVE's markets are highly competitive and changes in the demand for, or quality of, WAVE products, or in the operational or financial performance of the WAVE joint venture, could have a material adverse effect on its financial condition, liquidity or results of operations. Similarly, the availability and cost of raw materials, packaging materials, energy and sourced products, and the ability to pass along increased costs, are critical to WAVE's operations and its results of operations.

We believe the relationship with our partner, Worthington Enterprises, Inc., is an important element in the success of this joint venture. If there is a change in ownership, a change in control, a change in management philosophy, a change in business strategy or another event with respect to our partner that adversely impacts our relationship, WAVE's performance could be materially and adversely impacted. In addition, our partner may develop economic or business interests or goals that are different from or inconsistent with our interests or goals, which may impact our ability to influence or align WAVE's strategy and operations with our interests or goals.

headings: 收購及投資於未合併附屬公司
paragraphs: Armstrong World Industries, Inc. ("AWI" 或 the "Company") 為一間設立於 1891 年的賓夕法尼亞州公司。當我們在本報告中使用 "we," "our" 和 "us" 時，我們指的是 AWI 及其子公司。

AWI 是美洲地區在設計與製造創新室內與室外建築應用產品的領導者，包括天花板、特殊牆面與室外金屬解決方案。我們製造與來源的產品包含多種材料，包括礦物纖維、玻璃纖維、金屬、毛氈、建築用樹脂與玻璃、木材、木纖維與玻璃增強石膏。我們也透過與 Worthington Enterprises, Inc. 合資的 Worthington Armstrong Venture ("WAVE") 製造天花板吊掛系統 (grid) 產品。
我們的營運分部如下：礦物纖維、建築專用產品與未分配企業部門。

礦物纖維 – 生產吊掛式礦物纖維與玻璃纖維天花板系統。我們的礦物纖維產品提供多種性能特徵，例如音響控制、防火等級保護、能源效率，以及其他健康與永續性特徵與美觀吸引力。天花板產品主要銷售給經銷商、天花板系統承包商與經銷商，以及零售商（包括大型家居中心）。礦物纖維分部也包含 WAVE 的結果，該公司製造與銷售吊掛系統 (grid) 產品與天花板零組件產品，這些產品由 AWI 與 WAVE 同時開立發票。與 WAVE 相關的分部結果主要為權益收益，反映我們在合資公司的 50% 股權。天花板零組件產品包括天花板邊緣與裝飾條，以及支撐乾壁天花板系統、結構性與可行走式吊掛系統的 grid 產品。對部分客戶而言，WAVE 會將其吊掛系統產品銷售給 AWI 以轉售給客戶。礦物纖, 繊維分部結果反映這些銷售交易。礦物纖維分部也包含所有未特別分配給我們建築專用產品或未分配企業部門的資產與負債，包括我們位於賓夕法尼亞州蘭開斯特總部的所有不動產及相關折舊。礦物纖維分部的營運結果包含大量分配給企業部門的行政費用，這些費用代表合理分配的一般服務以支持其營運。

建築專用產品 – 設計、製造與來源特殊天花板、牆面及其他室內與室外建築應用產品，主要用於商業場域。產品可使用多種材料，例如金屬、毛氈、建築用樹脂與玻璃、木材、木纖維與玻璃增強石膏，並有各種顏色、形狀與設計。這些產品提供多樣的設計選項與性能特徵，例如音響控制、防火等級保護、光線、美觀吸引力、能源節約與建築性能。我們銷售標準、高階與客製化產品，其中部分來自第三方製造商。建築專用產品主要銷售給直接客戶，主要是天花板系統承包商，以及經銷商。此分部的收入主要由專案驅動，這可能導致銷售模式的變動性較高。建築專用產品分部的營運結果包含部分分配給企業部門的行政費用，這些費用代表合理分配的一般服務以支持其營運。
未分配企業 – 包含未分配至我們其他業務分部的某些資產、負債、收入與費用，包含：現金與現金等價物、我們 Overcast Innovations LLC 投資與相關權益收益與損失、美國退休收入計畫 ("RIP") 的淨資產負債狀況、利率期貨合約的預估公允價值、我們高階有擔保信貸融資下的未償還貸款，以及所得稅餘額。

我們的業務建立在提供高品質、創新產品的基礎上，透過高度有效的服務模式，以及維持強大的品牌認知與信任。我們致力於透過強化我們的核心礦物纖維分部與擴展我們的建築專用產品分部至新的、相關的業務類別與產業，來實現獲利性收入成長、強勁現金流產生與可持續的股東價值。透過此策略，我們已實現每單位銷售的礦物纖維銷售金額的穩定成長，透過產品創新，包括我們的 Templok® 節能天花板磚、Total Acoustics® 解決方案與 Sustain® 系列產品，並已建立廣泛的建築專用產品組合，用於天花板、特殊牆面與室外金屬建築應用。我們的成長計畫持續著重於市場驅動的創新與數位工具，以加速翻修並進一步區隔我們的產品與解決方案。此外，我們持續投資於擴展我們的建築專用產品市場與達成能力至新的相關產業，透過內生投資與收購。
2025 年 12 月，我們取得位於科羅拉多州 Englewood 的 FGM-Parallel LLC ("Parallel") 全部發行在外的股權。Parallel 是設計與製造擠壓鋁合金產品的公司，主要用於室外建築應用。Parallel 的營運、資產與負債已納入我們的建築專用產品分部。
於2025年9月，本公司取得Geometrik Manufacturing, Inc.（"Geometrik"）全部發行在外的股權，Geometrik位於加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省的Kelowna市。Geometrik為木質聲學天花板與牆面系統的設計與製造商。Geometrik的營運、資產與負債已納入本公司建築特殊產品應報告分部。
於2024年12月，本公司取得A. Zahner Company（"Zahner"）全部發行在外的股權，Zahner位於美國密蘇裏州的Kansas City市。Zahner為外牆金屬建築解決方案的設計與製造商。Zahner的營運、資產與負債已納入本公司建築特殊產品應報告分部。
於2024年4月，本公司取得3form, LLC（"3form"）全部發行在外的普通合夥權益，3form位於美國猶他州的Salt Lake City市，由Hunter Douglas, Inc.轉讓。3form為建築用樹脂與玻璃產品的設計與製造商，產品應用於特殊牆面、隔間與天花板。3form的營運、資產與負債已納入本公司建築特殊產品應報告分部。

於2024年1月，本公司與McKinstry Essention, LLC簽訂戰略合作協議並進行股權投資，成立Overcast Innovations LLC（"Overcast"），本公司以550萬美元換取Overcast初始19.5%股權（目前為19.2%）。Overcast為提供預製天花板雲端系統、模組化格柵平台與工程設計服務的解決方案公司，用以降低建築環境中的浪費與低效率。本公司對Overcast的投資與股權收益及損失已納入本公司未分配企業應報告分部。
於2023年10月，本公司取得Insolcorp, LLC（"Insolcorp"）部分營運與特定資產，Insolcorp位於美國北卡羅萊納州的Albemarle市。Insolcorp開發、測試與製造應用於建築與屋頂安裝的節能產品。取得的Insolcorp營運、資產與負債已納入本公司礦物纖維應報告分部。
於2023年7月，本公司取得BOK Modern, LLC（"BOK"）全部發行在外的股權，BOK位於美國加州的San Rafael市。BOK為外牆金屬建築解決方案的設計商。BOK的營運、資產與負債已納入本公司建築特殊產品應報告分部。

於2024年12月，我們取得位於密蘇裏州Kansas City的A. Zahner Company ("Zahner") 全部發行在外股權。Zahner為室外金屬建築解決方案的設計與製造商。Zahner的營運、資產與負債已納入我們的建築專用產品應報告分部。
於2024年4月，我們從Hunter Douglas, Inc.取得位於猶他州Salt Lake City的3form, LLC ("3form") 全部發行在外股東權益。3form為用於特殊牆面、隔間與天花板的建築樹脂與玻璃產品設計與製造商。3form的營運、資產與負債已納入我們的建築專用產品應報告分部。

於2024年1月，我們與McKinstry Essention, LLC簽訂戰略合作協議並進行股權投資，於Overcast Innovations LLC ("Overcast") 貢獻550萬美元，換取初始19.5%股權（目前為19.2%）。Overcast為提供預製天花板雲端系統、模組化格柵平台與工程設計服務的解決方案公司，以減少建築環境中的浪費與低效率。我們對Overcast的投資與股權收益及損失已納入我們的未分配企業部門。
2023年10月，本公司取得Insolcorp, LLC（"Insolcorp"）位於北卡羅萊納州Albemarle部分業務及資產。Insolcorp開發、測試並製造用於建築與屋頂安裝的節能產品。取得的Insolcorp業務、資產及負債已納入本公司礦物纖維分部。
2023年7月，本公司取得位於加州San Rafael的BOK Modern, LLC（"BOK"）全部發行在外股權。BOK為外觀金屬建築解決方案的設計公司。BOK的業務、資產及負債已納入本公司建築專用分部。
截至2025年12月31日，本公司運作22座製造廠，包括美國境內19座製造廠及加拿大3座製造廠。
WAVE在美國另外運作7座製造廠，用以生產懸吊系統（格柵）產品，本公司用於並銷售於天花板系統。
本公司營運分部如下：礦物纖維、建築專用及未分配企業部門。

礦物纖維－生產懸吊礦物纖維及纖維玻璃天花板系統。本公司礦物纖維產品提供多種性能特點，如音響控制、防火等級、能源效率，以及其他健康與永續特點及美觀吸引力。天花板產品主要銷售給經銷商、天花板系統承包商及經銷商，以及零售商（包括大型居家中心）。礦物纖維分部亦包含WAVE的營運結果，WAVE製造並銷售懸吊系統（格柵）產品及天花板零組件產品，這些產品由AWI與WAVE共同開票。與WAVE相關的分部營運結果主要為權益收益，反映本公司在合資公司的50%權益。天花板零組件產品包含天花板邊緣與裝飾件，以及支持乾壁天花板系統、結構性與可行走格柵系統的格柵產品。對部分客戶而言，WAVE將其懸吊系統產品銷售給AWI，再由AW、I轉售給客戶。礦物纖維分部營運結果包含這些銷售交易。礦物纖維分部亦包含所有未特別分配至本公司建築專用或未分配企業部門的資產與負債，包括本公司賓夕法尼亞州蘭開斯特總部的所有不動產及相關折舊。礦物纖維分部的營運結果包含大部分分配企業行政費用，這些費用為合理分配一般服務以支持其營運的費用。

headings: 與我們營運相關的風險
銷售波動及與主要客戶關係的變化可能對我們的財務狀況、流動性或營運成果造成重大不利影響。
與我們策略相關的風險
我們可能無法從戰略性措施中獲得預期的效益，包括在產品創新與數位化方面的投資。
我們無法保證未來會發放現金股息或根據股份買回計畫進行股票買回。
負面稅務後果可能對我們的財務結果產生未預期的影響。
與法律及監管事項相關的風險
本公司之智慧財產權權利可能遭侵佔、不當使用、無效或以其他方式繞過，此情形可能對本公司之財務狀況、流動性或營運成果造成重大不利影響。
與總體經濟及其他因素相關之風險
不穩定之市場與經濟環境可能對本公司之財務狀況、流動性或營運成果造成重大不利影響。
本公司業務依賴北美洲之建設活動。建設活動之衰退或延宕可能對本公司之財務狀況、流動性或營運成果造成重大不利影響。
本公司業務依賴第三方廠商與供應商，若其表現不盡理想，可能對本公司之財務狀況、流動性或營運成果造成重大不利影響。
公共衛生疫情或大流行病可能對本公司之財務狀況、流動性或營運成果造成重大不利影響。
paragraphs: 本公司對主要客戶（包括國家居家中心客戶或獨立經銷商）之銷售額之減損、波動或任何不利之業務關係變動，無論係因客戶需求與期待之變更、競爭、產業集中、供應鏈限制或其他因素所致，均可能對本公司之財務狀況、流動性或營運成果造成重大不利影響。
若本公司製造用料或來源產品之可取得性降低，或其成本增加，而本公司無法因應供應鏈或通貨膨脹壓力所導致的成本增加，則可能對本公司之財務狀況、流動性或營運成果造成重大且不利之影響。

原物料、包裝材料、能源及來源產品之可取得性與成本，對本公司營運及營運成果至關重要。例如，本公司製造作業中使用大量天然氣及部分石油基原物料。本公司部分材料來自有限或單一供應商，這會增加無法取得之風險。供應鏈之限制可能導致製造用料或來源產品之取得困難，或大幅提高購買這些物品之成本。未來原物料成本之波動可能因供應商對政府貿易政策（包括關稅）或地緣政治事件之暴露而發生。製造用料或來源產品之可取得性降低或成本增加，以及任何無法透過價格上漲轉嫁成本之情形，均可能對本公司之財務狀況、流動性或營運成果造成重大不利影響。
本公司與WAVE之合資企業之營運表現對財務結果至關重要。WAVE產品之需求或品質變動，或合資企業之營運或財務表現變動，均可能對本公司之財務狀況、流動性或營運成果造成重大不利影響。同樣地，若與合資企業之合作夥伴關係發生變動，且對本公司造成不利影響，則WAVE之表現可能受到重大且不利之影響。
本公司對WAVE合資企業之股權投資對財務結果仍至關重要。WAVE之市場高度競爭，若WAVE產品之需求或品質變動，或合資企業之營運或財務表現變動，均可能對其財務狀況、流動性或營運成果造成重大不利影響。同樣地，原物料、包裝材料、能源及來源產品之可取得性與成本，以及轉嫁成本之能力，對WAVE之營運及營運成果至關重要。

本公司認為與合作夥伴Worthington Enterprises, Inc. 之關係是此合資企業成功之重要因素。若合作夥伴發生股權變動、控制權變動、管理哲學變動、業務策略變動或其他事件，而對本公司之關係造成不利影響，則WAVE之表現可能受到重大且不利之影響。此外，合作夥伴可能發展出與本公司利益或目標不同或不一致之經濟或業務利益或目標，這可能影響本公司影響或協調WAVE之策略與營運與本公司利益或目標之能力。
